{{Top|leg}}
The '''Quekka fish''' was considered a delicacy on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. A civil war on the [[Fish/Legends|fish's]] native planet resulted in a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] waste spill that [[Death/Legends|killed]] off a huge part of the Quekka fish population.
